title: A read-only Claude child refused a `termal review-freeze-check` Bash line is not pointed to termal_review_freeze_check, its supported route
outcome: When a read-only Claude delegation's Bash line invokes the compiled freeze checker (`"$TERMAL_CLI" review-freeze-check …`, `termal.exe review-freeze-check …` or similar), the refusal still names the rule it broke: here, a variable can't be checked, and running TermAl's own executable is not a read-only command. It also names the supported route for that delegation, the `termal_review_freeze_check` MCP tool (docs/features/review-freeze-verification.md), with its two inputs. The read-only gate's decision is unchanged and stays fail-closed: no executable, variable or script is admitted. A test covers the refusal text.
acceptance: A read-only Claude child refused a `termal review-freeze-check` Bash line is not pointed to termal_review_freeze_check, its supported route is done
